obligation.title: Printed menus for the Harbour food festival
obligation.duty: Deliver 1200 printed menus to the festival office before the gates open.
excuses: a strike or blockade that stops carriers serving the delivery route
an order of a public authority that closes the venue or the route
a fire, flood or storm that damages the goods or the print works

claim: A storm flooded the print works on the night of 2 May. The water damaged the press and ruined the first run of menus, which had to be printed again.
